# ip6tables-save from the same VPS: Docker chains left behind, input open.
*filter
:INPUT ACCEPT [950497:66534844]
:FORWARD ACCEPT [0:0]
:OUTPUT ACCEPT [953836:66709384]
:DOCKER - [0:0]
:DOCKER-USER - [0:0]
:DOCKER-FORWARD - [0:0]
-A FORWARD -j DOCKER-USER
-A FORWARD -j DOCKER-FORWARD
-A DOCKER-USER -j RETURN
COMMIT
*nat
:PREROUTING ACCEPT [0:0]
:INPUT ACCEPT [0:0]
:OUTPUT ACCEPT [0:0]
:POSTROUTING ACCEPT [0:0]
:DOCKER - [0:0]
-A PREROUTING -m addrtype --dst-type LOCAL -j DOCKER
-A OUTPUT ! -d ::1/128 -m addrtype --dst-type LOCAL -j DOCKER
COMMIT
